title: aniflow named allenk frame repair configuration v1
description: Closed caller-selected image-only allenk/GeminiWatermarkTool interface at source revision 7c6a99f2c3df97eb3c430ef87a0c962aea5cb80e. Explicit current/legacy selection, fixed argv and disabled denoising keep selected profile assets bound to the pinned executable. The installed native host and shared-library environment remain unobserved; source interface support is not native qualification. No caller argv, model discovery, downloads, video processing or automatic profile fallback is allowed.

watermark_profile.description: Explicit visible-overlay family. Current V2 disables legacy fallback; legacy V1 skips the current-profile attempt. No automatic profile selection.

detection_threshold_percent.description: Detection confidence threshold in whole percent; Rust generates a fixed decimal argv value such as 25 -> 0.25. This does not grant automatic edit selection or certify a detected overlay.

maximum_working_bytes.description: Aggregate working-data admission, not a filesystem reservation or process memory quota. Independent outer provider limits still apply.
